section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Image States Scale (BISS), a 6-item measure used to assess daily body satisfaction on a 9-point Likert scale. The scale demonstrated good internal consistency (Cronbach's alphas .83 to .90) across study days, with a mean weekly score of 5.10 (SD = 1.11) across participants. This is a methods/measures section and does not contain study-level demographic or outcome data.
